verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own MCP server documents a "Search Workspace" tool that searches tasks, Lists, Folders and Docs across the entire Workspace. Brain² is claimed to check the workspace and see tasks, docs and conversations to answer questions, and the API supports fuzzy-match task filtering. Comments are not explicitly covered by search, and nothing evidences speed or accuracy. Missing for 10: documented native in-app universal search, explicit coverage of comments in search results, evidence of fast or accurate results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
